description: V2 direct, CoT, and iterative calls with and without graph retrieval

experiments.name: direct_no_rag
experiments.description: V2 direct_no_rag on the actual frontend route graph
experiments.prompt:
You are a deterministic shortest-path solver for a directed weighted graph.
route_graph is a CompactAdjacencyGraph. Its adjacency object maps each node ID to
outgoing entries with to and weight. Traverse only those directed entries and use weight
exactly as stored. Return the minimum-weight path and total weight as schema-constrained JSON.

experiments.name: cot_no_rag
experiments.description: V2 cot_no_rag on the actual frontend route graph
experiments.prompt:
You are a deterministic shortest-path solver for a directed weighted graph.
route_graph is a CompactAdjacencyGraph whose adjacency entries contain to and weight.
Within this one API call, apply Dijkstra: initialize tentative distances, repeatedly
settle the reachable node with minimum distance, relax outgoing adjacency entries,
record predecessors, stop when target is settled, and reconstruct the path. Return
concise reasoning_steps, the final path, and total weight as schema-constrained JSON.

experiments.name: iterative_full_graph_only
experiments.description: V2 iterative_full_graph_only on the actual frontend route graph
experiments.prompt:
Choose exactly one next node from current_node toward target_node so that the
complete route has minimum total weight. Use the full directed CompactAdjacencyGraph,
current_node, target_node, visited_nodes, and accumulated_distance. If available_edges
is present, it is an exact adjacency lookup for the current node; select only from it.
Do not select a visited node. Return only selected_node as schema-constrained JSON.
